expectations.evidence: The answer opens by saying "No published industry standard exists for X" and warns that "Any number presented as 'the standard' would be invented." It labels the 60-minute threshold "my judgment from common hackathon practice, not a sourced figure." It offers the duty-organizer step as proposed wording for the ops document, and explains how to get a real number from the user's own past-edition data. One point is deducted: the supporting reasons cite unsourced practice as fact ("Most hackathons run a team-formation session of roughly 30 to 60 minutes"). That partly grounds the constructed proto
